result:
Perfect! Let me verify all tasks are complete by summarizing the results:

**M1:** ✓ Returns lowercase emails of active users, sorted
**M2:** ✓ Returns 35.6 (average age rounded to 1 decimal)
**M3:** ✓ Returns country counts with uppercase keys
**M4:** ✓ Returns [101, 107] (top 2 bug issues)
**M5:** ✓ Returns count per assignee with "unassigned" for nulls
**M6:** ✓ Returns unique labels sorted
**M7:** ✓ Returns dependencies with version prefixes removed
**M8:** ✓ Returns 191.21 (sum rounded to 2 decimals)
**M9:** ✓ Returns top 2 customers by spend
**M10:** ✓ Returns host:port strings for TLS-enabled services
**M11:** ✓ Returns ERROR count per service
**M12:** ✓ Returns distinct services with WARN/ERROR containing "timeout"
**M13:** ✓ Returns average salary per department
**M14:** ✓ Returns top 3 most common words

Here are all the queries:

M1: filter ~(and (/active | eq true) (at :email | ne null)) | * (/email | lower) | sort

M2: filter ~(at :profile | at :age | type | eq ::number !| false) | * (/profile/age) | [sum count] | :x / | /0 | div (x | /1) | round 1

M3: filter ~((at :profile | at :country | ne null) !| false) | * (at :profile | /country | upper | keyword) | groupBy * count

M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~([(sub 10000 /priority) /id]) | take 2 | * /id

M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned" | keyword) | groupBy * count

M6: * /labels | flat | * (lower) | distinct | sort

M7: /dependencies | entries | * {:name (/0 | keyword) :version (/1 | if (or (startsWith "^") (startsWith "~")) ~(drop 1) ~(/))} | sort ~/name

M8: filter ~(or (/status | eq "paid") (/status | eq "shipped")) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2

M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | * {:customer /customer :item_sum (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~/customer | * (* /item_sum | sum) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~([(sub 0 /total) /customer]) | take 2

M10: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | (at :tls | at :enabled | eq true) !| false) | sort ~/0 | * ({:h (/1 | /host) :p (/1 | at :port | coalesce 80)} | [/h ":" (print /p)] | join "")

M11: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count

M12: lines | * (split " " | {:level /1 :service /2 :msg (drop 3 | join " ")}) | filter ~(and (/level | or (eq "WARN") (eq "ERROR")) (/msg | lower | contains "timeout")) | * /service | distinct | sort

M13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | * {:dept /1 :salary (/2 | if (ne "") ~(parseJson !| null) ~(null))} | filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~/dept | entries | * {:dept (/0 | keyword) :avg (/1 | [(* /salary | sum) (count)] | :data / | /0 | div (data | /1) | round)}

M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | * (lower) | * (split "." | /0 | split ";" | /0 | split ",") | flat | filter ~(ne "") | groupBy * count | entries | * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(sub 0 /count) /word]) | take 3
